stem:
A pitcher throws a ball toward a player holding a softball bat. The player uses the bat to hit the ball. The bat applies a 10-newton force to the ball.

Which statement correctly describes the reaction force between the bat and ball?

options.label: A
options.text: The reaction force is the force that causes the ball to move toward the bat.

options.label: B
options.text: The reaction force is the force applied to the bat by the player holding the bat.

options.label: C
options.text: The reaction force is the force that pulls the ball toward the ground.

options.label: D
options.text: The reaction force is the force of the ball on the bat.
